headline: Deepak Builders & Engineers India Limited: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4)
sum: DBEIL filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) of the Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011, indicating a material change in shareholding or acquisition event requiring public disclosure to the stock exchange.
detail: Deepak Builders & Engineers India Limited submitted a copy of its Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on 19 June 2026. Under SEBI Takeover Regulations, any person acquiring 5% or more of voting shares must disclose details including the acquirer's identity, number of shares acquired, price/consideration, timing, and intent. This disclosure is a mandatory first-stage filing in the Indian M&A/takeover regime and typically triggers further regulatory milestones (open offer, exemptions, or RHP review if applicable).
